about: The realistic twins' rows as the dashboard serves them (`readQuotesTwin`), made by docs/agents/backtests/twins/scripts/fixture.ts from the twins' spec rows (`specs`), in the page's order: "Stablecoin quotes USDT/GBP LIVE twin" (`live600`, £600), "Stablecoin quotes USDC/GBP LIVE twin" (`rxu120`, £120), "Stablecoin quotes variant-1" (`live1200`, £1,200), "Stablecoin quotes variant-2" (`take50`, £600), "Stablecoin quotes variant-3" (`n600no03`, £600), "Stablecoin quotes USDT 2:1 from 10-28" (`n600usdt2`, £600), "Stablecoin quotes variant-4" (`n600usdt`, £600), "Stablecoin quotes variant-5" (`n600nudge`, £600), "Stablecoin quotes variant-6" (`live600x1`, £600), "Stablecoin quotes LIVE control from 10-29" (`live600ctl`, £600).
